# Seoul Walk Tours

> Private, personally-guided tours in Seoul, South Korea. Run solo by Slam (Yoo il Min), a former international press fixer and road manager — no agency, no middleman markup. Prices are built from real cost plus a minimal margin.

## Who this is for
Individual travelers and small groups (1-25 people) who want an English-speaking private local guide in Seoul, rather than a joined group tour.

## Services
- Airport Transfer: one-way private pickup/drop-off between Incheon or Gimpo Airport and Seoul.
- Walking & Transit Tour: private guided tour by subway and on foot, half-day, full-day, or evening.
- Private Car Tour: private car and guide, fixed half-day/standard/full-day Seoul highlight routes, or a Custom Travel Trip for airport-combined or off-route requests.
- 4D Private Seoul Highlights with DMZ / Nami Island: 4-day, 3-night multi-day private tour.
- Best of Korea (7 days) and Grand South Korea (12 days): multi-day private itineraries covering Seoul, DMZ, Gyeongju, Busan, and (12-day) Jeju and Sokcho.

## Key facts
- Pricing is transparent and floor-based (real cost + minimal margin), shown in USD.
- No hidden middleman or platform fee.
- Guide speaks fluent English and Korean.
- Payment accepted in KRW, USD, EUR, GBP by cash, bank transfer, or Wise.
